identity.description: An attacker uses Windows encryption tools to encrypt files on the system, mimicking ransomware behavior. Cortex detects this through suspicious process execution and file encryption activity. The behavioral ABIOC looks for unusual process start patterns and file access.

payload.code:
certutil.exe -encrypt -f -p "password123" C:\temp\test.txt C:\temp\test.txt.enc

certutil.exe -decrypt -f -p "password123" C:\temp\test.txt.enc C:\temp\test.txt.dec

powershell.exe -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory('C:\temp\', 'C:\temp\backup.zip')"

net use Z: \\192.0.2.1\share /user:attacker password123

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Certutil Usage
biocs.description: Detects usage of certutil.exe for file encryption/decryption
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'encrypt'
| filter action_command_line contains 'decrypt'

abiocs.name: Unusual File Encryption Process
abiocs.description: Detects process behavior involving file encryption using certutil and PowerShell
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'encrypt'
| filter action_command_line contains 'decrypt'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: Suspicious Certutil Execution
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'encrypt'
| filter action_command_line contains 'decrypt'
